posts.title: Creativity in Computer Science
posts.description: A recent project: working with University of Oregon computer science professor Michal Young to develop graphic interludes for open-source computer science textbooks. Interlude 1, “Conquering Harder Problems with Abstraction” in the CS 210 textbook Interlude 2, “Careers in Computing,” in the CS 210 textbook

posts.title: This Could Fix Everything
posts.description: You can see the more charming print version on Allia’s site, or buy a print copy or a PDF. We’re actively collecting things for volume 2 (I don’t know if you’ve noticed, but not everything seems fixed yet. Still working on it). So: if you’ve got anything that could fix everything, drop me a line.
